question: what is the percentage change in the after-tax share-based compensation cost from 2009 to 2010?
reasoning: We need percentage change in after-tax share-based compensation cost from 2009 to 2010. The document gives share-based compensation cost and income tax benefit. After-tax cost = cost - tax benefit. For 2010: cost $18.1 million, tax benefit $6.3 million -> after-tax = 11.8. For 2009: cost $14.6, tax benefit $5.2 -> after-tax = 9.4. Percentage change = (11.8 - 9.4)/9.4 = 2.4/9.4 = 0.255319... = 25.53%. Need exact figures as printed: 18.1, 6.3, 14.6, 5.2. Compute.
raw_content:
<evidence>
18.1 | Share-based compensation cost 2010
6.3 | Income tax benefit 2010
14.6 | Share-based compensation cost 2009
5.2 | Income tax benefit 2009
</evidence>

<program>
divide(subtract(subtract(18.1, 6.3), subtract(14.6, 5.2)), subtract(14.6, 5.2))
</program>

<answer>25.53%</answer>
